caption:
You don't have to blow up what's working to see if something better exists.

Most owners stall on a new system because they picture a messy migration: lost leads, retrained staff, a month of chaos.

That's not how a real test runs.

Run the Black Arrow platform next to your current process for two weeks. Keep answering calls the way you do now. Let the new system catch what falls through anyway: after-hours calls, missed texts, slow follow-ups.

If it doesn't earn its spot, you cancel. No card on file, nothing to unwind.

rationale: Carousels still lead saves/depth for B2B objection content, and this resolves a genuinely unclaimed switching/migration-risk fear via the trial's no-card two-week test, distinct from every prior cost, impersonal, lock-in, complexity, spam, and adoption objection already shipped.
